about.title: About
about.p1: The Vietnam Fatherland Front Committee of Phong Hai Commune (Lao Cai Province) is a political alliance and voluntary union of socio-political organizations and people from all walks of life in the commune.
about.p2: This portal aims to communicate the policies of the Party and State; to highlight emulation movements, good models and exemplary citizens; and to receive feedback from the people.
about.p3: (Detailed introduction content will be updated by the agency.)
